boards.observations: Both new arms and V63/V43 suppress noise but omit the fine canopy cords visible in exact synthetic GT. Cloud wisps and building/railing texture are softened. Connected and detached look close in these fixed views; no clear detached detail benefit.

Connected/detached, V63 and V43 look close on the plate and color-chart ROIs. Plate surface striations are softened against the independent AHD reference; the fine pale curved line remains. An isolated bright chart point remains in both new arms. RawNIND shows softer/purple-fringed chart edges. No clear detached advantage; AHD is not exact RGB GT.

Both new arms and V63/V43 look close on brown apple/illustration ROIs, with smoothed surface variation and broad boundaries. RawNIND has softer illustration boundaries. Independent AHD contains residual grain; these two views cannot establish whole-image or cross-camera superiority.

All learned methods strongly reduce sky grain. V82/V83 remain close to V63/V43 on building, foliage and fence. Foliage is soft against the independent ISO100 f/5.6 reference. The four experimental models retain more continuous fence diamonds than the broken/checkered RawNIND-channel result. No clear detached advantage in the fixed regions; reference aperture/exposure/motion differ.

The selected dark carrier is nearly erased in both learned outputs. The brighter carrier remains much weaker than analytic GT. Flat output is smooth; connected/detached differences are small. Native appearance agrees with the failed signed-gain gates and does not establish weak-detail recovery.

Both new models show much less bright-magenta mottling than V63 in the selected palette, while retaining slight nonuniformity versus flat analytic GT. Orange and gray look close between the two arms. No clear detached visual advantage; full numeric color groups remain necessary.

All three models omit or strongly soften the fine cyan neon-wave detail visible in the independent ISO100 image. Broad platform railing/sign geometry remains similar between connected/detached and V63, without a clear new detached-specific fringe in these fixed views. ISO100 brightness/aperture/motion differ, so no pixelwise GT conclusion is made.

Both new models reduce the parent's pink/magenta mottling in the extra palettes and keep peach/ochre close to analytic GT. Mild purple spatial variation remains. Connected/detached differences are small in these four fixed cells; the palette set does not establish general color accuracy.

quality_decision.reason: Both parent-based known/unseen camera requirements fail; matched photo effect is negative; ADC and high-noise detail gains miss original requirements. Native crops retain missing cords, soft foliage/clouds and neon-wave detail without a clear detached advantage.

manual_review.limits: Fixed development ROIs and one matched training seed. Independent real ISO100/AHD references are not exact GT; finite native review does not rule out other failures. Synthetic GT is exact at the declared binned evaluation resolution. All original criteria remain unchanged.
